title: DIY Online Tax Return Options
body:
Just looking for some advice - HR Block used to have the ability to complete online tax returns through their portal but have now capped refund tax returns to be under $9999 due to ‘ATO scrutiny’. If over you must go through their agents…more fees.
After completing these for some years you realise as long as you have kept good records there really isn’t much too them but with the changes will come significantly more costs to complete one (completely understand this is deductible).
Does anyone have an alternative or another platform they have used and recommend?
